claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.fixed_save_dc
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic items can grant spell casts that use a fixed item DC instead of the wielder's own spellcasting DC.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "cast one of the following spells (save DC 13) from it"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spell_override_target_filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: A granted spell access sometimes modifies the spell's target domain without introducing a separate spell identity.
